document.abstract: A four-language motion-picture projection system was designed for the Third United Nations Atoms for Peace Conference. A double-system 16mm projector was modified to play four language soundtracks. These were fed to the theaters through appropriate distribution equipment. Translating, recording, and editing the foreign language soundtracks posed an unusual problem and special production procedures were adopted to cope with the difficulty.
